purpose: Turn the post-Waves 1-5 scaffold rollup into a strict next-work queue that prevents solver, rate, savings, waste/fraud, department-cut, technology-savings, or balanced-budget claims before required evidence is ready.

work_queue.title: Source custody and official current-law paths
work_queue.why_first: No solver input, policy delta, or public rate can be trusted until official annual source custody and current-law paths exist.
work_queue.progress_note: The full coverage matrix now marks current-law baseline and source-custody gates partial for all 15 lanes, the current-law progress rollup and Wave B closure are linked, and the eight-gap acquisition status is attached, but no current-law path values, solver inputs, rates, or savings are ready.

work_queue.title: Trust-fund and general-fund annual reconciliation
work_queue.why_second: OASDI, Medicare HI, transportation trust funds, the general fund, reserves, and explicit interfund transfers must reconcile before any integrated solver output.

work_queue.title: Outcome-floor thresholds and pass/fail evidence
work_queue.why_third: Every lower-cost scenario must pass access, quality, equity, adequacy/resilience, and delivery-feasibility floors.

work_queue.title: Policy-specific scored scenarios
work_queue.why_fourth: Federal effects require actual policy instruments, behavior, transition cost, incidence, administration, and floor passage, not sensitivity arithmetic.

work_queue.title: Receipt-base, distribution, and rate model
work_queue.why_fifth: Statutory and effective rates cannot be published before matched receipt bases, behavior, incidence, distribution, administration, and interactions are modeled.

work_queue.title: Payment-integrity scoring lineage
work_queue.why_sixth: Payment integrity is non-additive and cannot produce savings credit without causal prevention or same-cohort debt-to-collection lineage.

work_queue.title: Net-interest feedback fixture
work_queue.why_seventh: Net interest is endogenous; primary-balance changes must recompute deficit, debt, maturity-bucket debt stock, and future interest before solver outputs.

work_queue.title: Deterministic solver dry run
work_queue.why_eighth: Only after current-law paths, fund reconciliation, floors, policy scores, receipt bases, payment-integrity lineage, and net-interest feedback exist can a narrow deterministic solver run.

plain_english_status: The next phase is ordered, not ready. Source custody and current-law paths now have partial matrix-visible progress for all 15 lanes, with the current-law progress rollup, Wave B closure, and eight-gap acquisition status attached, but rank 1 remains blocked because complete official annual paths and source custody are not done. Then reconcile funds, set outcome floors, build policy-specific scores, model receipt bases and distribution, establish payment-integrity lineage, add net-interest feedback, and only then attempt a deterministic solver dry run. This queue publishes no values, rates, savings, waste/fraud findings, department cuts, technology savings, solver outputs, or balanced-budget claim.
